method: Run the new regressions in an isolated archive of the preceding committed source against owned filesystem/PostgreSQL fixtures. The working tree/history were not reset.
observed_failures: A named-pipe open outlived the integrity context deadline.
Publication followed an unsupported tenant namespace symlink and wrote into the other owned fixture namespace.
A worker credential expired during its metadata callback but the old transaction still committed.
scope: Unsupported local filesystem layout and worker transaction expiry. This does not establish a remotely creatable symlink exploit or full storage/platform/security qualification.
